messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-03-28] standup/ember/2025-03-28: The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature flag service on every run.
- [2025-03-19] standup/ember/2025-03-19: Deploys to the scheduler happen on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2026-02-23] standup/dune/2026-02-23: The job scheduler deploy window (unchanged): on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-10-27] standup/dune/2025-10-27-2: New deploy window for scheduler: on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. Forget the previous weekdays after 15:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-01-17] standup/boreal/2025-01-17: The notification service depends on the bus for delivery events. If the event bus is down, the webhook dispatcher is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2026-05-08] incident-review/INC-2026-009: INC-2026-009 review. What happened: scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. Why: two leaders elected during a network partition. Follow-up decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-06-13] standup/ember/2025-06-13: Decision: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: For the record, scheduler is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-08-29] handover/2025-08-29-scheduler: Ownership change: the scheduler now sits with team Cinder. Ember no longer owns it.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19-2: Team Ember noticed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-10-15] handover/2025-10-15-scheduler: From today the pager for scheduler rings Dune, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-03-04] standup/dune/2026-03-04: The webhook dispatcher remains a team Dune service.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31: The event bus remains a Boreal service.
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas/2025-03-10: Dependency map update: the billing service needs the ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-05-05] standup/boreal/2025-05-05: Reminder that the billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.
- [2025-02-28] standup/cinder/2025-02-28: Dependency map update: search-indexer needs the product catalog (product documents). Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2: Observation from Atlas: after the runtime upgrade, the scheduler's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-09-05] handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-08-29: the scheduler went to Atlas, not team Cinder. Team Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-03-10] standup/dune/2026-03-10-2: Observation from team Dune: after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. The webhook dispatcher deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-04-16] standup/ember/2026-04-16: The ledger service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. The old slot (Wednesdays 09:00-11:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: The bus deploy window: on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-12-16] standup/ember/2025-12-16: The ledger service deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-10-13] standup/cinder/2025-10-13: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki. Reminder that the search indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2026-03-16] standup/boreal/2026-03-16: From today the product catalog deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC instead of on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-04-08] standup/dune/2025-04-08: Reminder that the reporting service depends on the ledger.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The notifier lives with Boreal. The webhooks service lives with Boreal.
- [2025-04-08] standup/cinder/2025-04-08: Reminder that the indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-01-29] standup/ember/2025-01-29: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-02-25] standup/boreal/2025-02-25: Webhooks still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.

Question: Which service depends on the scheduler?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: which service depends on the scheduler?

Let me scan the memory for dependencies involving the scheduler.

Memory entries:
- Scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature flag service — that's the scheduler depending on the feature flag service, not the reverse.
- Notification service depends on the bus.
- Billing depends on ledger.
- Search-indexer needs product catalog.
- Reporting service depends on ledger.
- Webhooks relies on bus.
- Indexer depends on catalog.

No entry says any service depends on the scheduler. The scheduler pulls from feature flags (scheduler depends on feature flag service, not vice versa).

So the answer: I don't know.
